module: ImGui window "Drag - Set Dial" for bracket racing: the local player enters their dial (announced time, in seconds) in a decimal field, from 0 to 999 (10 by default, or the value stored in the vehicle's dial book). On confirmation, in solo the callback applies the dial; in multiplayer the value is sent to the host via drag.updateTimerValue(raceId, vehId, 'dial', val). Only shown if the track is of type bracketRace.
notes: Only one popup at a time: requestDial is ignored if it is already open or if vehId is nil/-1.

The comment of tick() says it is called from core.lua, but no file in lua/ references dialPopup (neither core.lua nor dragBridge): in 0.40.5 this extension seems unused (the dial goes through dragBridge.showDialControl and the UI).
An invalid entered value or one outside [0, 999] is replaced by 10 (DIAL_DEFAULT).
The window closes by itself if dragData is absent or if dragType is not bracketRace.
The window texts are hardcoded in English (no translation).

requestDial.desc: Opens the dial entry window for a vehicle. Pre-fills with the stored dial (key importantTimerId, otherwise time_1_4) or 10.

vehId.desc: Player's vehicle ID (ignored if nil or -1).

callback.desc: Called with the confirmed value (number) after validation.

tick.desc: Draws the window if it is open (only once per frame). Meant to be called manually every frame, not as an extension hook.
